validation_notes: The chart shows a clear, sustained downtrend from ~7.4 (early Jul) to ~6.4-6.6 (early Aug) with lower highs and lower lows in a stair-step pattern, not a converging triangle. Near the right edge, price has flattened somewhat around 6.5-6.65, but this looks more like consolidation after a downtrend / potential base rather than a descending triangle with a flat support and falling resistance. There isn't a clearly flat lower support line with repeated touches - the lows near the right edge (6.35-6.65) are choppy without a consistent horizontal floor, and the 'highs' aren't forming a clean descending line either - they're relatively flat/sideways too, resembling more of a range/consolidation than a converging wedge. The overall structure is dominated by trend, not compression, so I disagree with the algorithm's descending triangle flag; this looks more like the tail end of a downtrend transitioning into sideways consolidation.
